paper_id: Pattern learning for scheduling microservice workflow to cloud containers
title: Pattern learning for scheduling microservice workflow to cloud containers
venue: International Journal of Machine Learning and Cybernetics
motiation: 大量计算在调度过程中重复,因为微服务工作流存在很多相似子结构
problem_framing: 将微服务工作流调度问题形式化为带软截止日期约束的DAG调度到异构容器
key_insight: 通过GNN挖掘工作流中的模式子结构,复用排序结果可避免重复计算
method_signature: PMWSC框架: GNN模式识别 → 工作流排序 → 任务排序(PB-TS) → 资源选择(PB-RS)
evaluation_criteria: 平均延迟(average tardiness)和调度方案生成时间(runtime)
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: 当资源不足时,PMWSC的延迟高于HEFT-D和PEFT-D; 算法并非总是最优
evidence_for_taste: a lot of computations are repeated in a scheduling process
little attention has been paid on mining similar substructures
the order of tasks from the same pattern is order-preserved
no task sorting is needed from the same pattern
our framework is more suitable for the environment with sufficient resources
thinking_moves: 从重复计算切入: 识别工作流相似子结构可减少调度计算量
将模式信息预嵌入调度两阶段(任务排序+资源选择)以简化搜索空间
先分策略做参数标定(Turkey HSD), 再比较整体框架效果
承认算法依赖资源充足性条件,非万能解
cites_own_work: Li, W., Li, X., Ruiz, R.: Scheduling microservice-based workflows to containers in on-demand cloud resources. In: CSCWD 2021
extraction_notes: 评估部分有图表被截断,部分数值结果不完整,但方法论和实验设计完整可见 | md truncated to head40k+tail20k
